units.id: news:painter|"He who can, creates; he who cannot, transports. Sorry, no offense meant to you."|659|0
units.english: "He who can, creates; he who cannot, transports. Sorry, no offense meant to you."
units.italian: "Chi sa, crea; chi non sa, trasporta. Scusa, non volevo offendere te."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"All of human space is linked into a single communications network by relay beacons. It's something that most people just take for granted."|820|0
units.english: "All of human space is linked into a single communications network by relay beacons. It's something that most people just take for granted."
units.italian: "Tutto lo spazio umano è collegato in un'unica rete di comunicazioni tramite boe ripetitrici. È una cosa che ai più sembra ovvia."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"Hyperspace links don't just allow faster-than-light travel. They also allow near-instantaneous communication, if you have the right sort of relay on both ends."|821|0
units.english: "Hyperspace links don't just allow faster-than-light travel. They also allow near-instantaneous communication, if you have the right sort of relay on both ends."
units.italian: "I collegamenti iperspaziali non permettono solo viaggi più veloci della luce. Consentono anche comunicazioni quasi istantanee, se hai il tipo giusto di ripetitore a entrambe le estremità."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"The hyperspace communications network is a marvel of public infrastructure, but most people just take it for granted."|822|0
units.english: "The hyperspace communications network is a marvel of public infrastructure, but most people just take it for granted."
units.italian: "La rete di comunicazioni iperspaziali è una meraviglia di infrastruttura pubblica, ma ai più sembra ovvia."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"Hyperspace relays are so integral to society that even pirates don't dare to touch them. They'd easily become the number one enemy of the Republic if they did."|823|0
units.english: "Hyperspace relays are so integral to society that even pirates don't dare to touch them. They'd easily become the number one enemy of the Republic if they did."
units.italian: "I ripetitori iperspaziali sono così essenziali per la società che perfino i pirati non osano toccarli. Se lo facessero, diventerebbero subito il nemico numero uno della Repubblica."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"I'm surprised at how many people on Earth are still using the old IPv4 protocol. None of the off-Earth websites are reachable for them."|824|0
units.english: "I'm surprised at how many people on Earth are still using the old IPv4 protocol. None of the off-Earth websites are reachable for them."
units.italian: "Mi sorprende quanta gente sulla Terra usi ancora il vecchio protocollo IPv4. Nessun sito fuori dalla Terra è raggiungibile per loro."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"Have you ever set up a TCP/IP connection from Bourne to a server on Farpoint? I have. It's a little slow, but it works!"|825|0
units.english: "Have you ever set up a TCP/IP connection from Bourne to a server on Farpoint? I have. It's a little slow, but it works!"
units.italian: "Hai mai aperto una connessione TCP/IP da Bourne a un server su Farpoint? Io sì. È un po' lenta, ma funziona!"

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"Do you know the DRQ of the HSBE for the hyperlanes around here? You don't understand? Sorry, a hyperlane can be thought of as a corridor through space..." The engineer gives a long-winded and confusing explanation of hyperlanes.|826|0
units.english: "Do you know the DRQ of the HSBE for the hyperlanes around here? You don't understand? Sorry, a hyperlane can be thought of as a corridor through space..." The engineer gives a long-winded and confusing explanation of hyperlanes.
units.italian: "Sai qual è il DRQ dell'HSBE per le corsie iperspaziali qui intorno? Non capisci? Scusa, una corsia iperspaziale si può immaginare come un corridoio attraverso lo spazio..." L'ingegnere fa una lunga e confusa spiegazione delle corsie iperspaziali.

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"It might take hours to get a message a few systems away going through the hyperspace relays, but it sure beats taking multiple days to send a ship or multiple centuries to send a message at light speed."|827|0
units.english: "It might take hours to get a message a few systems away going through the hyperspace relays, but it sure beats taking multiple days to send a ship or multiple centuries to send a message at light speed."
units.italian: "Possono volerci ore per far arrivare un messaggio a pochi sistemi di distanza passando per i ripetitori iperspaziali, ma è comunque meglio che impiegare giorni per mandare una nave o secoli per mandare un messaggio alla velocità della luce."

units.id: news:hyperspace relay engineer|"Someone with more money than sense asked me to refill the hyperspace relays, because their signal was low."|828|0
units.english: "Someone with more money than sense asked me to refill the hyperspace relays, because their signal was low."
units.italian: "Uno con più soldi che buonsenso mi ha chiesto di ricaricare i ripetitori iperspaziali, perché il segnale era debole."

units.id: news:republic soldier|We recently went to full alert, because somebody screamed "It's scrambled!" Turns out some rookie in the galley was enthusiastic about making scrambled eggs.|1804|0
units.english: We recently went to full alert, because somebody screamed "It's scrambled!" Turns out some rookie in the galley was enthusiastic about making scrambled eggs.
units.italian: Siamo passati all'allarme rosso poco fa, perché qualcuno ha urlato "È criptato!" Pare che un pivello in cambusa avesse voglia di uova strapazzate.

units.italian: Un mucchio di grandi etichette con scritto "carne di prima qualità" è accanto a contenitori di cibo con etichette più piccole: "non commestibile per l'uomo".

units.id: news:goods handling|A box with a label saying "this side up" is placed upside down on a cart.|2206|0
units.english: A box with a label saying "this side up" is placed upside down on a cart.
units.italian: Una scatola con l'etichetta "questo lato in alto" è appoggiata capovolta su un carrello.

units.id: news:spaceport video advertisement|You see a video of stuntmen making a jump from the edge of space. The "do not try this at home," "illegal on many planets," and "high risk/deadly" warnings at the end of the video suggest that this might become quite a popular sport.|2219|0
units.english: You see a video of stuntmen making a jump from the edge of space. The "do not try this at home," "illegal on many planets," and "high risk/deadly" warnings at the end of the video suggest that this might become quite a popular sport.
units.italian: Vedi un video di stuntman che si lanciano dal bordo dello spazio. Gli avvisi "non provateci a casa", "illegale su molti pianeti" e "rischio elevato/mortale" alla fine del video fanno pensare che potrebbe diventare uno sport piuttosto popolare.
